results: Baseline reproduction: a loading lifecycle change cancels the ready RAF and the sent latch prevents recovery
Fixed pipeline resumes after loading changes; readiness requires a completed draw, is idempotent and cleans up
Asset completion alone cannot authorize scene readiness or a transition
Late prefetch completions cannot regress ready/transitioning lifecycle state
Cancelled attempts cannot publish readiness/failure or complete a later navigation
Retry invalidates failed callbacks; repeated return requests do not create new attempts
